When generating commit messages use Conventional Commit style. 

Type: A mandatory noun indicating the nature of the change (e.g., feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, chore).
feat: Introduces a new feature.
fix: Patches a bug.
BREAKING CHANGE: Can be part of any type and indicates a breaking API change, correlating with a MAJOR version bump in semantic versioning.
Scope (optional): A phrase describing the section of the codebase affected by the change, enclosed in parentheses (e.g., fix(parser):).
Description: A concise, imperative summary of the change.
Body (optional): Provides more detailed contextual information about the code changes.
Footer (optional): Used for referencing related issues (e.g., Fixes #123) or indicating BREAKING CHANGE information.
